top_band: yellow-tan woven mat surface with blue fish on top and wooden frame border (rows 1-17)
evidence: Rows 1-17 show the foreshortened top surface of the drying rack (wooden frame enclosing a woven reed mat with five blue fish lying on it). Row 17 is the lighter brown front edge of the frame, row 18-19 is the front apron face, row 20 is the dark underside/shadow, and rows 20-24 show the front and back legs set back underneath.

style.evidence: The wood frame uses 5 brown steps including a dark-brown material outline; the woven mat has vertical grain strips shaded across left-to-right lighting; the small fish have 4 blue-teal tones plus dark eyes. Information density and craft match the Beodeul stall and well references.
